lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Guided practice A: corresponding parts of congruent triangles

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Use this example as the model for the guided set below.

items.prompt: Two sides and the included angle are congruent. Which criterion?

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: Two triangles share two pairs of congruent sides and a pair of congruent angles that are not between those sides. Why does this fail to prove congruence?
choices: Two sides are never enough information under any circumstances.
The angle must be a right angle for any criterion to apply.
The unknown side can close the triangle in two different ways, producing one acute and one obtuse triangle from the same measurements.
The triangles are congruent, but the criterion is simply named differently.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 35° and ∠B = 34°. Find ∠F.
Two figures are congruent if and only if …
choices: they have the same perimeter
they can be scaled to match
they have the same area
there is a sequence of rigid motions taking one exactly onto the other

items.prompt: In two triangles, two pairs of corresponding angles and a pair of non-included sides are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
choices: SSS
SAS
AAS
ASA

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 20° and ∠B = 71°. Find ∠F.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 52° and ∠B = 38°. Find ∠F.
If a sequence of rigid motions maps △ABC onto △DEF, then …
choices: every pair of corresponding sides and angles is congruent
the triangles have equal area but need not be congruent
only the corresponding angles are congruent
only the corresponding sides are congruent

items.prompt: In two triangles, two pairs of corresponding sides and the pair of included angles are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
choices: SAS
ASA
SSS
AAS
